FILENAME EXAMPLE — REPLACE THE NAME & VERSION

WHAT BELONGS HERE

Our filename recipe

Project abbreviation + Version name (optional) + Shot number + Save version

HVN_Vertical_0010_v001Hemaviton · Vertical
VRT_Summer_0010_v001Valorant · Summer
GCR_0010_v001GoCar · no version name

Use single underscores. Leave the version name blank when there is only one version. Shot number: 4 digits. Save version: lowercase v + 3 digits. Add the actual file extension, such as .blend or .mp4.

A repeatable handoff

Start a shot. Keep everything together.

Use File Explorer to copy the template. This guide does not create folders or configure your applications.

Paths in the folder explorer show the reusable template. For real work, replace _SHOT_TEMPLATE with your shot name, such as HVN_Vertical_0010.

ONE-TIME PROJECT SETUP

Project settings

Enter the project name here. The file cards will use its abbreviation automatically.

Usually the name of your project’s top-level folder.

3 letters suggested from the name. You can edit the suggestion.

Add version

Name each campaign or delivery version, such as Main, Vertical or Summer. These names are separate from numbered save revisions (v001, v002).

Enter a count to generate the name fields. Use 0 for filenames without a version name. Changes stay in this draft until you save project settings.
